dedupe_keys.name: land use plans for industrial estates in the netherlands bestemmingsplannen voor bedrijventerreinen in nederland

description: This dataset collects the land-use plans (bestemmingsplannen) for industrial estates and business parks in the Netherlands, with maps, regulations and explanatory texts. The 4TU.ResearchData and DataCite records say it covers plans from 2001 to 2009, in Dutch, with PDF, KML, zip and text media types. It was published in August 2010 by Erik Louw of TU Delft as one downloadable zip of about 2.0 GB and a PDF readme, under the 4TU general terms of use at no cost. Coverage is Dutch industrial estates. Caveats: the plans are legal planning documents, not a coded database, the number of estates covered is not stated on the page read, and most plans will have been replaced since 2009 (current plans are published on the national Ruimtelijkeplannen portal, which was not read). For simulation it gives permitted uses, building limits and zoning of industrial sites, to set what can be built or relocated on an estate in land-use and hazard exposure models. Related catalogue records include the Hotmaps industrial sites and the EU industrial emissions portal.
